prediction_text: Sir William Waller shall overcome; Sir Ralph Hopton will be defeated. Waller's significators are far the stronger: the Moon in her exaltation with Jupiter, and the Sun, lord of Waller's substance and assistants, in the 10th in the very degree of his exaltation (19° Aries). Hopton's significator Saturn is wholly debased — sub radiis, in his fall, peregrine, in no aspect to any planet — and there are no supplies ready for him (only Mars and the South Node in the 9th). The Moon, swift and increasing in light, distant 11° from Venus, carries the advantage to Waller's side in this very engagement (day-scale: decided in this fight, the day of the figure).
basis: tradition: horary（卡面载明）。systems_used: horary。已载面：两军胜负（主问）。断项过闸：Waller胜←月亮擢升合木星＋其财助之主太阳居十宫正得擢升度；Hopton败←七宫主土星伏日下、入弱、无定位、无相位＋九宫仅火星与南交点（无后援）。对象核：承受对象为两军主将各自阵营，逐方分断未混同。应期为当日交战即决，日档有据（图即战日所立）。
